name: OGBL-WikiKG2: Wikidata Knowledge Graph Completion Benchmark
description: OGBL-WikiKG2 is a large-scale knowledge graph benchmark extracted from Wikidata, consisting of 2,500,604 entities, 535 relation types, and 17,137,181 relational triplets. It is designed to evaluate link property prediction (knowledge graph completion) by predicting tail or head entities given an entity and a relation (h, r, ?). Evaluated under a time-stamped split where validation and test sets contain facts that emerged later in time than training triplets (Train: 16,109,182 triplets, Validation: 429,456 triplets, Test: 598,543 triplets), evaluating the model's ability to extrapolate to newly emerging facts using 1,000 negative candidates per test query.
